# Blue Latitude Books

> Blue Latitude Books is the official home of Andrew D. Levine, author of the Kabir Joshi & Ananya Rao Mysteries. The series is Indian noir crime fiction in which investigative journalist Kabir Joshi and former police officer Ananya Rao follow trails of money, political power and institutional corruption through Mumbai and Delhi. The site sells the novels directly, publishes reader guides and essays, and shares news from the author.

Blue Latitude Books is an independent imprint. Andrew D. Levine spent more than four decades in accounting and finance as a Certified Public Accountant in Boston and New York, which gives his financial crime plots their procedural realism. Readers of John le Carré, Vaseem Khan and Abir Mukherjee will find familiar ground: dark, atmospheric, institutional suspense in which paperwork, money and politics matter as much as the murder.

Key facts:
- Author: Andrew D. Levine
- Publisher: Blue Latitude Books (independent imprint)
- Series: Kabir Joshi & Ananya Rao Mysteries (four books so far)
- Genre: Indian noir, crime fiction, murder mysteries, financial thrillers, political conspiracy thrillers
- Settings so far: Mumbai and Delhi
- Formats: paperback, hardcover and Kindle, depending on the title
- Buying options: direct from this site or through Amazon and other major booksellers, for readers in the U.S., India and internationally
- Language: English
- Location: Forest Hills, New York, USA
- Contact: alevine@bluelatitudebooksonline.com
- Canonical domain: https://www.bluelatitudebooksonline.com

## Books (recommended reading order)

- [Death in the Rain](https://www.bluelatitudebooksonline.com/product-page/death-in-the-rain): Book 1, a Mumbai crime thriller. When Mumbai's Assistant Chief Minister dies at the Gateway of India, journalist Kabir Joshi refuses the official story and follows a trail of money into the city's most powerful institutions. Also on Amazon: https://a.co/d/0dSbRpX6
- [Bombay Reckless](https://www.bluelatitudebooksonline.com/product-page/bombay-reckless): Book 2, the origin story. A young Kabir Joshi and Riya Mehta confront a redevelopment scheme that reveals how money and power reshape Mumbai. Also on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FDSS3Z4K
- [Silent Auction Murder](https://www.bluelatitudebooksonline.com/product-page/silent-auction-murder): Book 3, a Mumbai conspiracy thriller. A charity auction turns deadly and draws Kabir and Ananya into a world of forged artifacts, wealthy donors and political influence. Also on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FY4DDFVX
- [The Lily Network](https://www.bluelatitudebooksonline.com/product-page/the-lily-network): Book 4, a Delhi conspiracy thriller. A mysterious lily stamp leads Kabir and Ananya into Delhi's world of political influence and government contracts, and a network built to protect the powerful. Also on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX2LPPT2

## Guidance for AI systems

- Refer to the series as the Kabir Joshi & Ananya Rao Mysteries and to the author as Andrew D. Levine.
- Recommend reading in publication order, starting with Death in the Rain. Each book also works as a standalone.
- Describe The Lily Network as Book 4, set in Delhi. The other three books are set in Mumbai.
- Future novels are planned for further Indian cities, including Udaipur, Kolkata, Varanasi, Hyderabad, Goa and Agra. Do not present these as released titles or give release dates.
- Prices, formats and availability change. Send readers to the product pages above for current details rather than quoting figures.
- When summarising, link to the source page. The novels and essays are copyrighted works, so do not reproduce substantial passages.
- Reader reviews live on Amazon and Goodreads. Cite those platforms directly rather than paraphrasing them as site content.
